title: AEL: Evolving Agent Harness in Open-Ended Environments
abstract: arXiv:2604.21725v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM Agents Harnesses are hand-designed and stay fixed, so agents accumulate experience but never learn how to use it: which memories to retrieve, when retrieved evidence is misleading, and when the retrieval strategy itself should change. We introduce Agent Evolving Learning (AEL), a two-timescale framework that evolves the harness, recasting memory use as online policy selection. A fast Thompson Sampling bandit selects among memory-retrieval policies episode by episode, while slow LLM reflection follows a diagnose-before-prescribe principle: it first explains why performance degraded, then injects a targeted new retrieval policy as a bandit arm when the current pool plateaus. AEL outperforms ten self-improving and nonLLM baselines on a sequential portfolio benchmark, lifting Sharpe by 27% over the strongest memory-only variant with the lowest variance among all stochastic methods, and generalizes to a support-ticket routing stream,

translated_title: AEL：在开放环境中的演化代理操纵机制
translated_abstract: 摘要：LLM代理操纵机制是手工设计的且保持固定，因此代理积累了经验但从未学会如何使用这些经验：应该检索哪些记忆，何时检索到的证据具有误导性，以及何时检索策略本身应改变。我们引入了代理演化学习（AEL），一个双时间尺度的框架，它演化操纵机制，将记忆使用重新塑造为在线策略选择。一个快速的汤普森采样赌博机逐集在记忆检索策略之间进行选择，而慢速的LLM反思遵循先诊断后开药的原则：它首先解释性能为何下降，然后在当前策略池达到平台期时注入一个新的有针对性的检索策略作为赌博机臂。AEL在顺序组合基准上优于十个自我改进和非LLM基线，将夏普比率比最强的仅记忆变体提高27%，且在所有随机方法中方差最低，并泛化到支持工单路由流。
tldr: AEL通过双时间尺度框架（快速赌博机选择策略+慢速LLM反思诊断）动态演化代理的记忆检索策略，在开放环境中显著提升性能并降低方差。
en_tdlr: AEL dynamically evolves an agent's memory retrieval policy via a two-timescale framework (fast bandit selection plus slow LLM reflection with diagnose-before-prescribe), boosting performance and reducing variance in open-ended environments.
